data.title: 瑕光 · 贴纸和明信片
data.description: 她挑了一枚小马贴纸放到明信片角落，左右挪了几次才贴下。写完问候，她准备把它寄给家人。
data.camera: 中近景，明信片与贴纸清晰
data.promptProse: At a sunny wooden writing desk covered in colored pencils and stamps, Blemishine carefully peels a cute stylized pony sticker, pressing it onto the corner of a handwritten postcard to her sister. Daylight filters through fluttering lace curtains, catching the grain of the wooden desk, an inkwell, and envelopes stacked neatly for mailing.
data.animaCaption: Seated at a sunlit wooden desk cluttered with pencils and stamps, she carefully presses a small pony sticker onto the corner of a handwritten postcard. Morning daylight filters through fluttering lace curtains onto her gentle smile.
